name: INVEST – Grant for Venture Capital
description: A federal grant program that reimburses business angels for a portion of their investment in innovative startups.

name: B# (be sharp)
description: A pre-seed fund providing convertible bonds to early-stage deep tech startups in Berlin.

name: ProFIT
description: A joint state grant and loan scheme for technology-oriented R&D projects from idea to market launch.

name: GründungsBONUS Plus
description: A cost subsidy program for innovative and sustainable startups based in Berlin during their first two years.

name: Berlin Start
description: A loan program for Berlin-based startups providing favorable financing in conjunction with bank guarantees.

name: Start-up BW Pre-Seed
description: Interest-free, partly forgivable loans for innovative, growth-oriented startups in Baden-Württemberg requiring a co-investor.

name: Junge Innovatoren
description: Grant supporting young researchers from universities and research institutions to develop proof-of-concept projects.

name: CyberLab Accelerator
description: Free-of-charge nine-month accelerator program for IT, AI, IT-security, and smart production startups.

name: Start-up BW Innovation Fonds
description: Venture capital fund investing in high-tech startups in life sciences, digital transformation, and industrial innovation.

name: AI Startup Rising (AISR)
description: A comprehensive platform supporting AI startups from research ideation through incubation and acceleration.

name: Lean AI Startup Funding (LAISF)
description: Early-stage funding providing up to 35,000 EUR to help AI startup teams validate their business ideas.

name: HessenFonds
description: Loan-based financing instrument designed to support the liquidity and scaling needs of Hesse-based founders.

name: FLÜGGE
provider: Bavarian State Ministry of Economic Affairs, Regional Development and Energy
description: A Bavarian state-wide grant supporting university-based startups in innovation, research, and technology sectors.

name: Bayern Kapital
description: A state-backed venture capital firm providing equity financing to innovative high-tech startups and scale-ups in Bavaria.

name: EXIST Business Startup Grant
provider: Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action (BMWK)
description: A federal grant supporting knowledge-intensive startup projects from universities and research institutions to develop business plans and prepare for market entry.

name: Berliner Startup Stipendium
description: A scholarship program for research-driven startup teams from Berlin universities to develop scalable ventures in strategic technology fields.
